:::{#thm-exp-score}
#### Score function of an exponential variable

Let $X$ be an exponential random variable with mean $\pmean$.
The score of a single observation $x$ with respect to $\pmean$
is its deviation from the mean, divided by the variance:

$$\score = \frac{x - \E{X}}{\Var{X}} = \frac{x - \pmean}{\pmean^2}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-exp-score-fn.

:::
